source: full external evaluation, 2026-10-30, evidence at file:line as of commit 80748ab

issues.title: DNS rebinding defeats the mutation guard in tokenless CLI mode
issues.evidence: viewer/server.py:136-146 compares Origin netloc to Host header; under rebinding both are attacker-controlled and identical, and GET requests have no origin check at all. A malicious webpage can read the API and POST /api/runs/{id}/decision to approve consequential tool calls.
issues.fix_hint: validate Host against a loopback allowlist on every request

issues.title: Remembered approval is keyed by tool name, whitelisting all future arguments
issues.evidence: viewer/console_runtime.py:722-727 adds tool name to self._remembered; approving one run_command ls exempts every later run_command in the run, including python payload.py.
issues.fix_hint: key the memory on tool name plus an argument digest

issues.title: README claims budget enters the hash chain; the ledger is a mutable side table
issues.evidence: README.md line 41 lists 预算 among hash-chained records; core/store.py:61-67 defines budget as a plain mutable table updated via UPDATE (+?) at store.py:335-342 with no budget event type; replay.py:5-8 admits counters are not encoded in events.
issues.fix_hint: either emit budget events into the chain or correct the claim

issues.title: Receipt signing key stored in the same database as the signed data
issues.evidence: core/receipts.py:61-66 stores the HMAC key hex in the store's meta table; anyone able to tamper with events can also re-sign receipts. Module docstring admits it; README carries no qualifier.
issues.fix_hint: externalize the key or state the boundary in user-facing docs

issues.title: Unsynchronized reads on the shared SQLite connection can spuriously flag CHAIN_TAMPERED
issues.evidence: core/store.py:257-333 run bare self._conn.execute without the RLock writers hold under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; the threaded viewer (server.py:582) and chat worker threads share the store, so a read interleaved inside another thread's transaction sees new events with the old head.
issues.fix_hint: take the store lock on read paths and add a concurrent-read regression test

issues.title: Permission gate is a convention: Harness.execute() itself performs no checks
issues.evidence: runtime/harness.py:379-443 executes tools with zero permission checks; gating holds only because both in-repo call sites (runtime/loop.py:300, 565) call gate() first. Nothing structural stops a future caller from bypassing it.
issues.fix_hint: move the gate inside execute() as defense in depth

issues.title: A float inside a tool result crashes with an unhandled TypeError
issues.evidence: harness.py:247-268 converts proposal-side float rejection into PROPOSAL_MALFORMED, but the same canonical_json TypeError from digest(result) at tools/registry.py:74 is caught by neither harness.execute's except AgentError nor loop.run's.
issues.fix_hint: catch the float rejection at the result boundary with a stable error code

acceptance: the audit engine must independently detect at least 3 of these with re-playable evidence before Sprint 2 closes
